name: SuperHippo (Hippo)
description_en:
SuperHippo is the current branded customer-engagement suite linked from Jungleworks’ Hippo page. Its own product pages still use Hippo for live chat and ticketing and identify Jungleworks in company details. It combines conversational support, ticket tracking and marketing automation, with AI Voice Agent and WhatsApp-based NOTP as separate product areas.

For an illustrative delivery issue, a website conversation can collect context, reach an agent and become a ticket with an accountable team and email updates. A marketing journey for the same contact is a different permission and billing decision. Public pages do not establish complete identity,API,failure or recovery contracts. This is documentation research without an account,widget,workflow,call,WhatsApp login,subscription or export test.
description_zh:
SuperHippo是Jungleworks的Hippo页面当前链接的客户互动套件品牌。其自身产品页仍将在线聊天和工单称Hippo，公司资料标Jungleworks。它结合沟通支持、工单跟踪和营销自动化，AI Voice Agent及基于WhatsApp的NOTP属于不同产品领域。

以假设配送问题为例，网站对话可收集上下文、接客服并形成有责任团队及邮件更新的工单。同一联系人的营销旅程是不同权限和计费决策。公开页面未建立完整身份、API、失败或恢复契约。本稿研究文档，未测试账户、组件、工作流、通话、WhatsApp登录、订阅或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Bring website/app chat and supported communication channels into one operator dashboard.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将网站／应用聊天及受支持渠道汇入操作面板。

core_features.explanation_en: Create tickets from bots,live chat or the dashboard and notify customers of ticket events.
core_features.explanation_zh: 由机器人、聊天或面板建工单，并通知客户工单事件。

core_features.explanation_en: Group customers and agents,share tickets,tag teammates and add comments.
core_features.explanation_zh: 对客户和客服分组，分享工单、提及同事及评论。

core_features.explanation_en: Segment audiences and trigger personalized communications across configured channels.
core_features.explanation_zh: 对受众分组，跨配置渠道触发个性化沟通。

en: Pilot live-chat support with tracked follow-up for an order issue.
Evaluate support and marketing in the same suite while keeping their audiences and sending rights explicit.
zh: 试点订单问题的聊天支持及可跟踪后续。
评估同一套件的支持和营销，同时明确受众及发送权。
use_cases.basis: Editorial scenarios, not observed adoption or retention improvements.

Implementation choice.en: The support page describes a configurable widget,customizable UI kits and SDK/API-based custom experiences. No current SDK version,server authentication,rate limit or deployment license was verified.
Implementation choice.zh: 支持页描述配置组件、可定制UI kit及基于SDK／API的自定义体验，未核实当前SDK版本、服务器认证、限流或部署许可。

steps.zh: 确认当前SuperHippo账户、所选Support或Marketing套餐及适用商业条款。
选择组件／UI kit／SDK，以明确团队及工单负责人试点一次对话。
扩大使用前测试缺上下文、客服不可用、工单通知、动作失败及代表性导出。

items.en: Suite pricing,Voice Agent minutes and NOTP login billing are separate sections,not one all-inclusive support price.
items.zh: Suite价格、Voice Agent分钟及NOTP登录计费是分开部分，并非一个全包支持价。

items.en: Additional-agent cards show$25/month but the comparison includes$26 for some tiers. CurrenttermsalsoincludeanoldUS$5/agentpolicy.
items.zh: 附加客服卡列每月$25，比较表部分档列$26，当前条款还保留旧每客服5美元政策。

items.en: Voice-specific FAQs repeat on the chat page; they are not sufficient proof of identical chat workflow behavior.
items.zh: 语音专属FAQ重复于聊天页，不能据此证明聊天流程行为相同。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Support Starter年付折月$45或月付$109（4客服、20协作者、400文章）；Growth年付折月$139或月付$159（10客服、协作者不限、1000文章）。14天试用；附加客服卡$25，部分比较表$26，条款旧5美元。未确定持续免费档。

faq.question_en: Is the Get Started For Free button a permanent free plan?
faq.question_zh: 免费开始按钮代表永久免费档吗？
faq.answer_en: No current entitlement was established. Pricing describes a fourteen-day trial and loss of account access without a selected plan afterward.
faq.answer_zh: 此次未确定该权益。价格页描述14天试用，之后未选套餐则失去账户访问。

faq.question_en: Does Starter include every marketing and voice feature?
faq.question_zh: Starter包含所有营销及语音功能吗？
faq.answer_en: No. Support,Marketing,Voice Agent and NOTP have separate pricing scopes. Confirm the selected package rather than extending a suite headline to every module.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。Support、Marketing、Voice Agent及NOTP范围分别计价，应确认所选套餐，不将套件标题扩展到全部模块。

sources.site: Pricing plans that fits any budget | Hippo | Jungleworks
sources.title: Pricing plans that fits any budget | Hippo | Jungleworks

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Follow the current Hippo identity without merging every module
sections.title_zh: 沿当前Hippo身份区分各模块
sections.en:
Jungleworks’ assigned Hippo page links to SuperHippo. The current site identifies Jungleworks in its company footer,and its support/pricing pages still carry Hippo titles. The terms themselves mix Hippo and SuperHippo names. These links support following the current brand while preserving the original catalog slug; they do not establish that every old customer contract or integration has migrated unchanged.

The suite now presents chat,ticketing,marketing,voice AI and NOTP. This profile focuses on support and its handoff,with marketing and voice treated as adjacent purchases. The broad brand claims,anonymous testimonials and retention percentages were not independently verified. A customer should select a concrete workflow and package before treating the platform’s entire feature menu as an entitlement.
sections.zh:
Jungleworks所分配Hippo页链接SuperHippo，当前站点页脚标Jungleworks，支持／价格页仍带Hippo标题，条款也混用Hippo与SuperHippo。这些连接支持沿当前品牌整理并保留原slug，但不证明所有旧客户合同或集成原样迁移。

套件目前展示聊天、工单、营销、语音AI及NOTP。本档案聚焦支持交接，将营销及语音视作相邻购买。品牌宽泛主张、匿名评价及留存比例未独立验证。客户应先选具体流程及套餐，再判断功能菜单哪些属于权益。

sections.title_en: Make a conversation into an accountable ticket
sections.title_zh: 让对话成为有责任归属的工单
sections.en:
For an illustrative delivery issue,the chat widget captures a request and routes it to an agent. The ticketing page describes creation through chatbots,live chat or its dashboard,then organizing work by customer groups,agent teams and departments. It lists email updates for creation,comments,resolution and closure,plus colleague comments,tagging and shared tickets.

Test the transition using one customer,order reference,assigned team and explicit next response. A resolution label or sent update is not proof that a backend delivery problem was fixed. The public pages do not specify duplicate-ticket handling,concurrent ownership,private-versus-public comment visibility,reopen rules or failed-email recovery. A pilot should inspect an unavailable agent and an unresolved ticket rather than only the happy-path greeting.
sections.zh:
以假设配送问题为例，聊天组件采集请求并路由客服。工单页描述通过机器人、聊天或面板创建，再按客户组、客服团队及部门组织，列创建、评论、解决和关闭邮件更新，以及同事评论、提及和共享工单。

应以一个客户、订单号、责任团队和明确下一回复测试转换。解决标签或发出更新不证明配送后端问题已修复。公开页面未明确重复工单、并发归属、内外评论可见性、重开或邮件失败恢复。试点应检查客服不可用及未解决工单，而不只看成功问候。

sections.title_en: Choose widget convenience or a maintained custom integration
sections.title_zh: 选择组件便利或需维护的自定义集成
sections.en:
Conversational Support lists three implementation routes:a configurable chat/WhatsApp widget,a customizable UI kit and SDK/API-based custom UI/workflows. A UI kit’s visible source does not grant ownership of the hosted service or unrestricted redistribution. Exact supported SDK versions,API authentication,identity binding and error semantics were not established from these product pages.

For an app integration,verify how a returning user is identified,how logout separates accounts,and how a failed request reaches an operator. Do not assume a marketing phrase about automatic chat distribution documents ordered rules,transactional updates or guaranteed human availability. The chat page repeats voice-agent FAQs,so those answers cannot fill missing chat-specific operational details. No widget,SDK,account or API was exercised.
sections.zh:
Conversational Support列三种实施路线：可配置聊天／WhatsApp组件、可定制UI kit、以及SDK／API自定义界面和流程。UI kit可见源码不授托管服务所有权或无限再分发。产品页未确定准确SDK版本、API认证、身份绑定及错误语义。

应用集成需验证回访识别、退出隔离及失败请求如何到操作人员。自动分配营销措辞不能当有序规则、事务更新或保证真人在线的文档。聊天页重复语音代理FAQ，不能用来填补聊天操作缺口。此次未运行组件、SDK、账户或API。

sections.title_en: Separate support contact from marketing eligibility
sections.title_zh: 区分支持联系与营销资格
sections.en:
The marketing product describes segmentation,behavior/lifecycle rules and a journey designer across email,SMS,push,in-app and WhatsApp. That is a campaign workflow,not simply replying to an open support ticket. A person providing an order number for service is not automatically an approved marketing audience. Define the intended segment,sender rights and suppression behavior before an automated outreach.

An illustrative repeat-purchase journey should verify the event that qualifies a contact,the message channel and frequency,and what happens after an opt-out or failed delivery. The public summaries do not establish consent synchronization,retry limits,branch ordering or an automatic stop on a recent complaint. Provider/template charges and marketing reach can add to the suite subscription; neither unlimited chat nor unlimited broadcasts makes every channel free.
sections.zh:
营销产品描述跨邮件、短信、推送、应用内及WhatsApp的细分、行为／生命周期规则和旅程设计。这是活动流程，不只是回复支持工单。为服务提供订单号的人不自动成为获准营销受众，自动触达前需确定目标分群、发送权及抑制行为。

假设复购旅程应核对联系人入选事件、渠道、频率，以及退订或投递失败后行为。公开摘要未建立同意同步、重试限制、分支顺序或近期投诉时自动停止。提供商／模板及营销覆盖人数可额外收费，不限聊天或广播都不等于所有渠道免费。

sections.title_en: Use the package limits and resolve conflicting add-on prices
sections.title_zh: 采用套餐额度并解决附加价冲突
sections.en:
Current support cards show Starter with four agents,twenty ticket collaborators and four hundred articles;Growth includes ten agents,unlimited collaborators and one thousand articles. Monthly prices shown are$109/$159,or$45/$139per month with annual billing. Cards list additional agents at$25,but parts of the comparison show$26. A fourteen-day trial is described;without a selected plan afterward access ends. A Free-start button does not establish ongoing free use.

The terms still describe an olderUS$5per-support-agent policy,duplicated brand text and staging references. Do not normalize those inconsistent numbers into a verified checkout price. Voice AI minutes and NOTP login estimates are separate scopes;their billing mechanics and provider costs were not tested. Obtain a current order stating included modules,extra agents,taxes,commitment,quota behavior and trial conversion.
sections.zh:
当前支持卡Starter含4客服、20工单协作者、400文章，Growth含10客服、协作者不限及1000文章。月付显示$109／$159，年付折月$45／$139。卡列附加客服$25，但比较表部分列$26。文中有14天试用，之后未选套餐会失去访问，免费开始按钮不建立持续免费权益。

条款仍描述旧每支持客服5美元政策、重复品牌文字及测试环境引用，不能将冲突数字归一为已核实结账价。语音AI分钟和NOTP登录估价另有范围，机制及提供商费用未测试。需取得写明模块、附加客服、税、承诺期、额度及试用转付的当前订单。

sections.title_en: Confirm the governing service and an exit path
sections.title_zh: 确认适用服务及退出路线
sections.en:
The terms explicitly reserve proprietary software/service rights and restrict resale,source extraction and redistribution. They also mix general chat terms with white-label application and field-worker/GPS language. That drafting inconsistency is an observed scope problem,not proof of a particular author,cause or operational incident. It leaves contract applicability unresolved for a normal support-only tenant.

No complete export,attachment portability,restore plan,data-retention schedule or on-premise product was verified. Plan a representative ticket/transcript export before cancellation and reconcile actual access rights with the selected agreement. The public pricing FAQ says cancellation retains access until the billing-cycle end,but that does not establish a post-termination retrieval window. Brand continuity and a working sales page are not independent acceptance of reliability or compliance.
sections.zh:
条款明确保留专有软件／服务权，并限制转售、提取源码及再分发；它又将聊天、白标应用与外勤／GPS语言混合。这是观察到的范围起草问题，不证明作者、成因或运营事故，使普通纯支持租户适用合同仍不明。

此次未核实完整导出、附件迁移、恢复方案、数据留存表或本地产品。取消前应测试代表性工单／记录导出，并按所选协议确认访问权。价格FAQ称取消后可用至账期结束，但不建立终止后取回窗口。品牌延续与销售页可用不是可靠性或合规的独立验收。

seo.title_zh: SuperHippo／Hippo：聊天转工单及套件价格冲突
seo.description_en: Research the current Hippo identity,chat implementation,ticket ownership,marketing boundaries,agent/collaborator limits and conflicting prices.
seo.description_zh: 研究当前Hippo身份、聊天接入、工单归属、营销边界、客服／协作者额度及冲突价格。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate SuperHippo support under the Hippo product identity.

research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户、组件、SDK、工作流、通话、NOTP、提供商连接、报价、购买、导出或恢复。准确当前合同／价格、附加客服25／26、旧5美元范围、SDK身份／API错误、AI用量、渠道费、记录迁移、留存及界面语言未核实。
